subject: Nanotechnology
title: Nano Anodes for Lithium-Ion
description: A quick win: understand Nano Anodes for Lithium-Ion.

hook.text: Silicon stores ten times more lithium than graphite — but it swells 300% and cracks. Nano solves this.

buildup.text: Silicon nanoparticles and nanowires accommodate swelling without fracturing — small structures flex instead of breaking.

discovery.text: Nano-structured silicon anodes boost battery capacity from 372 to over 3000 mAh per gram of anode material.

twist.text: Continuous SEI formation on fresh silicon surfaces consumes electrolyte — capacity fades after hundreds of cycles.

climax.text: Engineered carbon-silicon core-shell nanoparticles now stabilize the SEI — commercial SiO anodes are in EV batteries.

punchline.text: Nano silicon flexes instead of cracking — unlocking ten times the capacity.

quiz.question: Why does nano-structured silicon solve the swelling problem in battery anodes?
options: Small structures accommodate volume expansion without fracturing
Silicon nanoparticles repel lithium ions to prevent swelling
